name: Allcargo Logistics Ltd
title: Allcargo Logistics Ltd - 532749 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Express volumes flat for FY26 and Q4 revenue flat YoY at INR514 crore; margin gains come from pricing actions and cost cuts, not volume, with no capacity or capex signals.

triggers.label: RPKG up via GPI and surcharges
triggers.quote: all these have had a positive impact on the yield and the RPKG over the last 6 months

triggers.label: Express volume flat for FY26
triggers.quote: They remained largely flat during FY '26 with surface express volume witnessing moderation sequentially.

triggers.label: EBITDA and PBT to grow ahead of revenue
triggers.quote: we expect our EBITDA and PBT to grow ahead of revenue in the coming quarters

guidance.metric: EBITDA and PBT growth vs revenue
guidance.value: EBITDA and PBT to grow ahead of revenue in coming quarters
guidance.quote: we expect our EBITDA and PBT to grow ahead of revenue in the coming quarters

guidance.value: 0.5 million sq ft in FY27, asset-light
guidance.quote: we have a plan to add 0.5 million square feet additional on the warehouse space and that would be done largely on an asset-light approach

prior_guidance_check.metric: Allcargo Global listing by Q4 FY26
prior_guidance_check.quote: the listing would be completed by quarter 4 of FY '26, but there has been no update so far

red_flags.label: PAT only INR6 crore despite EBITDA INR233 crore
red_flags.quote: EBITDA is improving to INR233 crores, but PAT remains INR6 crores

red_flags.label: Express volumes flat, weeded out customers
red_flags.quote: We even weeded out a few non-profitable customers

red_flags.label: Listing timeline slipped
red_flags.quote: there has been no update so far

evasions.quote: I will just address the question on Allcargo Global's listing
at the right point of time, we will recommend that to the shareholders, yes.
